title: One Account per Customer Profile — Harborline Customer Accounts
content:
# One account per customer profile

> Harborline Customer Accounts

## Clause

Each customer profile has exactly one Harborline account, which holds every product the customer buys. A new account may be opened only when the customer has no account in any status, and a closed account is reopened rather than replaced.

The limit is one account (1) per customer profile. Whether an account already exists is read from the account records held for that customer profile, not from what the caller says.

## What the clause means in practice

| Account already on the customer profile | Can a new account be opened? |
|---|---|
| None in any status | Yes |
| An account that is unverified, active, in recovery hold or locked | No |
| A closed account | No; the closed account is reopened rather than replaced |

Every product the customer buys, whether a domain, a hosting plan, a certificate, an email subscription, a server or a website security plan, sits on that single account.

## Points of judgement

- **Is a closed account still "an account in any status"?** Yes. Closure does not free the customer profile for a second sign-up; the closed account is the one that is reopened.
- **Can a second account be opened to separate a business's products from personal ones?** Not on the same customer profile: the profile holds exactly one account, and that account holds every product.
